न-पा + त्, नप्तृ नप्तृ (i. e. न-पा + तृ),
 I. m.
 1. A grandson,

.
 II. f. नप्ती नप्ती (i. e. न-पात् + ई), A granddaughter,

= Rigv. i. 50, 9, where the horses are denoted as granddaughters of the chariot.
 --Cf. Lat. nepos, neptis; O.H.G. nefo; A.S. nefa; O.H.G. nift; Goth. nithjis, nithjo; ἀ-νεψιός.

नपुंस + क,
 I. adj.
 1. Neither man nor woman.
 2. Of neuter gender.
 II. m.
 1. An eunuch,
नप्ती and नप्तृ नप्तृ, see नपात्.

नापित, based on the nom. sing. स्नापिता, i. e. स्नाप्, curtailed Causal of स्ना, + तृ.
 1. m. A barber,
. f. ति, The wife of a barber, Pañc. 37, 7.
